description: Lists keywords saved to a project, with whatever metrics have been cached for them (search volume, difficulty, CPC) and their tags. FREE — reads MisarSEO's own database, runs no provider lookup and charges no credits. Filter by keyword text with `search`; page through with `page` and `limit` (50, 100 or 250 rows per page — any other value is rounded down to one of those), ordered by `sort`/`order`. A metric is null when nothing has ever fetched it for that keyword — saving a keyword does not measure it. Null is not zero volume and not zero difficulty; run research_keywords to fill them. `totalCount` is how many keywords match the filter, and `rows` is only the current page of them, so report both.

limit.description: Maximum rows to return. Defaults to 100.

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

name: list_saved_keywords
